capabilities: Search PubMed, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar from a note
Generate structured research briefs with APA 7 in-text citations
Verify article DOIs against the Crossref API
Review and refine AI-selected articles with custom instructions
Configure LLM providers, models, research domains, and output languages
extras: README mixes English and Spanish and defaults to the 'Smart Plugins Obsidian (spob)' provider for key-less setup; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to query academic databases and turn verified results into a cited, traceable research brief.

summary: AI-assisted research tool that searches PubMed, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar and generates cited APA 7 research briefs inside notes.
